migration.strategy: Fresh Actestra profile v1; native AionUi profiles remain untouched. Forward-only schema v14 retains schemas v1-v13 exactly, including the bounded aionui_schedule_jobs authority table, schedule-owned Workspace grants, main-owned timers and claims, missed/interrupted recovery state, and fixed existing-conversation /actestra execution through the accepted General Work journey. Schema v14 adds only the bounded team_plans authority table for canonical admitted graphs, deterministic Actestra plan, node, and Task identities, record-digest verification, idempotent retry, and correlation/version conflict denial before scheduling. Forward-only schema v15 leaves schema v14 team_plans unchanged and separately adds team_definitions, team_runs, and append-only team_run_revisions for canonical Team identity, the current durable run head, deterministic transition replay, cancellation, recovery, and result references. Forward-only schema v16 leaves schemas v14-v15 unchanged and adds immutable team_experience_bindings so Main binds each Team identity to standard or orchestrated exactly once. Existing native AionUI Teams bind as standard on first Main-owned list/get projection; schema-v15 Actestra Team definitions bind as orchestrated; conflicts fail closed. Forward-only schema v17 leaves schemas v14-v16 unchanged and adds metadata-only standard_team_message_deliveries. Main persists a bounded client nonce and request digest before the provider effect, records an observed provider message/run acknowledgement only after the postcondition, marks ambiguous or restart-interrupted effects uncertain, and rejects automatic resends. Patch 0014 exposes this authority through one fixed main-frame Team request/event provider and AionUI-native creation, list, /team/:id, group-chat, plan/node/Worker state, dependencies, blocked explanations, protected approvals, pause/cancel/retry/replace/handoff controls, Artifacts, aggregation, and recovered-state guidance. The renderer receives only bounded Team DTOs, Actestra Workspace references, messages, explanations, valid actions, and Artifact references; it receives no filesystem path, private prompt, audit identifier, Worker/process identifier, credential, model/runtime override, or durable-state authority. The retained Agent Settings, ACP coding journey, Scheduled Tasks, General Work, Office, preview, navigation, loading, empty, and error behaviors remain available through their recorded R0/R1/R2 contracts. AionUI v2.1.41 remains the sole application shell and design system. No Goose, Eigent, or CrewAI application UI or complete runtime, no renderer-side Team-type guessing, and no second state authority is added.

Existing Actestra Tasks, events, approvals, and Artifacts remain authoritative and inert; no native profile edit or frozen-foundation change is required. Regenerate without patch 0012 to remove the main-owned isolated-coding session composition while retaining the accepted P5.2 library containment contracts. No coding session, renderer state, or frozen foundation file requires reversal. Regenerate without patch 0011 to restore the original AionUI cron provider wiring while retaining the accepted General Work and Office journeys. Existing schema v13 schedule rows and schedule-owned grants remain inert. Regenerate without patch 0010 to remove the preserved AionUI General Work journey bridge and /actestra SendBox intents while retaining GW-P4.5 recovery. The frozen AionUi foundation and native AionUi profiles stay byte-identical.
